items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Oh, you know the old man too? Yeah. Well, I'll be damned until you see you know them all then, don't you? ... We'll see you later, Paul.

ctx.x: Yeah, let me put something on here first. We want to get all our voices down. We want to put the date on for one thing too. Let's see, the day is July, huh? Yeah, the first of July, 1960. Mm-hmm. And this is in New Orleans.
And mine's Dick Allen. Okay, now let's see. We wanted to find out, how do you spell your name, the first thing?
